#WalangPasok: Class, gov't work suspensions for Monday, September 22, 2025
MANILA, Philippines – Malacañang has suspended classes at all levels and government work in Metro Manila and 29 provinces on Monday, September 22, 2025, due to Super Typhoon Nando (Ragasa) and the enhanced southwest monsoon (habagat).
Provinces covered by the Palace order are:
Batanes
Cagayan
Pangasinan
Bataan
Pampanga
Tarlac
Earlier, some local government units made separate announcements.
Metro Manila
Caloocan City – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
Las Piñas City – all levels, public and private
Malabon City – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
City of Manila – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
Marikina City – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
Navotas City – all levels, public and private
Parañaque City – all levels, public and private
Pateros – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
Cagayan Valley
Cagayan
Allacapan – all levels, public and private
Rizal – all levels, public and private
Santo Niño – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
Isabela
Roxas – all levels, public and private
San Isidro – all levels, public and private
Calabarzon
Batangas – face-to-face classes in all levels, public and private
Cavite province – all levels, public and private
Quezon Province
General Luna – all levels, public and private
Rizal
Antipolo City – all levels, public and private

TCWS No. 1
northern Pampanga (Mabalacat City, Magalang, Arayat, Candaba, Angeles City, Porac, Mexico, Santa Ana, San Luis, San Fernando City, Bacolor)
